items.title: Blackstone (BX) Stock May Be Above Fair Value Despite Strong Earnings
items.summary: Blackstone stock has delivered a strong 3 year return, yet the current market price screens as expensive on both an intrinsic value estimate and on market multiples. The key issue for investors is that Blackstone does not currently look like a clear bargain based on these checks. Over the past 3 years, Blackstone has returned about 50.8% which means recent investors have already seen substantial gains that may limit the margin for error at today’s price. items.title: Blackstone (BX), What Is Behind The Fresh Attention Today?
items.summary: Why Blupine Energy rumors matter for Blackstone stock Blackstone (BX) is back in focus after reports that Actis is exploring a sale of Indian renewables player Blupine Energy, with Blackstone listed among several potential bidders for the asset. The reported sale process, which sources say could value Blupine Energy between US$1.5b and US$2b, highlights how Blackstone continues to be linked to large scale energy and infrastructure assets in growth markets.
